description: This file defines a custom LightningJS component named 'Loader' that displays animated circles as a loading indicator. It imports the LightningJS 'Blits' module, registers the component with a template rendering three circles with transition effects, and includes lifecycle hooks and methods to control the animation.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays animated circles as a loading indicator.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the loading animation by toggling the 'alpha' property between 0 and 1 at 800ms intervals.
